# Smisul storefront. Only genuinely public, indexable pages are allowed —
# authenticated/administrative/transactional flows are excluded.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /api
Allow: /

# The sitemap is generated by the backend and exposed on the production domain.
